name: Dub techno
blurb: One chord, drowned in echo, over a soft kick.

sounds.name: Dub chord
sounds.why: A single dark minor chord sent through a long echo and a huge reverb. The chord is hit twice a bar; the echoes play the rest of the track.

ingredients.name: Make it dark
ingredients.adds: Takes off most of the top.
ingredients.listenFor: It sounds like it is in the next room.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: Too bright: it is a house stab.

ingredients.name: Stab it
ingredients.adds: A short hit, so the echoes are heard clearly.

ingredients.name: Long echo
ingredients.adds: Each hit repeats many times, fading slowly.

knobs.below: Too quiet to carry the track.
knobs.above: As loud as the chord itself.

knobs.label: feedback
knobs.above: The echoes never clear and build into a roar.

ingredients.name: Deep reverb
ingredients.adds: A very large, very wet room.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.below: The echoes sound dry and separate.

ingredients.name: Let the filter drift
ingredients.adds: The cutoff rises and falls over 16 bars.
ingredients.listenFor: The same chord slowly opens and closes. This is the only thing that changes in the track.

knobs.label: drift top
knobs.below: The drift is too small to notice.
knobs.above: It gets harsh at the peak.

pitfalls: Feedback and reverb both high: the low end fills up and the kick disappears.

sounds.name: Soft kick
sounds.why: A kick with the click filtered off, more a pulse than a hit. It has to sit under the echoes without cutting through them.

sounds.name: Sparse hats
sounds.why: A quiet hat on the offbeat that sometimes just does not play. The gaps are part of the groove.

ingredients.name: Offbeat hat
ingredients.adds: A closed hat between every pair of kicks, from the default kit.

ingredients.name: Turn it down
ingredients.adds: The hat sits far behind the chord.

knobs.label: level
knobs.above: It drives the track like house.

ingredients.name: Drop some at random
ingredients.adds: Each hat has a chance of not playing.

knobs.label: chance of rest
knobs.above: Too few are left to feel a pulse.

ingredients.name: Echo
ingredients.adds: The hats that do play leave a trail.

sounds.why: Two soft low notes a bar. More would crowd the echoes.

sounds.name: Dark pad
sounds.why: The same chord again, held and very dark, as a floor under the stabs.

sounds.name: Hiss and crackle
sounds.why: Tape hiss and vinyl crackle, added on purpose. It makes a clean computer sound like an old, worn record.

ingredients.name: Vinyl crackle
ingredients.adds: Random clicks, like dust on a record.

knobs.label: hiss level
knobs.below: You can't hear it, even in the gaps.

ingredients.name: Put it in the room
ingredients.adds: Sends the noise through the same reverb as the chord.
